description_en: Disconnects the identity source integration of a workspace. For CustomSSO, this operation clears the shared user pool and related SAML and SCIM resources. To disable only logon or synchronization, use the corresponding toggle operations
description_zh: 整体断开工作空间的身份源集成。CustomSSO 会清理共享用户池及相关 SAML、SCIM 资源；只关闭登录或同步时应使用对应开关接口
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore delete-identity-provider --workspace-id ws-123456 --identity-provider-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The type of the external identity provider to be disconnected. Valid values: DingTalk and Feishu. The value must be the same as the currently bound type
parameters.help_zh: 待解绑的外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu，取值必须与当前绑定的类型一致
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

data.description_en: The external identity provider binding information after the disconnection operation is accepted
data.description_zh: 解绑操作受理后的外部身份提供商绑定信息

configuration.description_en: The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only in GetIdentityProvider. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual receiving status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

bindingType.description_en: HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. Queries return the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be non-empty and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. Existing configurations cannot be replaced. This is different from the entity ID of the service provider (SP) queried on our side
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

ssoStatus.description_en: The actual switch value, which is Enabled or Disabled. This is not equivalent to the expected value of loginEnabled saved in AC
ssoStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled，不等同 AC 保存的 loginEnabled 期望值
ssoStatus.title_en: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态
ssoStatus.title_zh: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态

identityProviderType.description_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk and Feishu
identityProviderType.description_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu

protocol.description_en: Only SAML is currently supported. This parameter may not be returned if no valid configuration is saved. OIDC placeholder initialization is not supported
protocol.description_zh: 当前仅支持 SAML；未保存有效配置时可不返回。不支持用 OIDC 占位初始化

saml.description_en: The input supports either XML or complete manual entry. Queries return the standardized configuration and do not echo the original XML. This parameter can be omitted if it is not configured
saml.description_zh: 输入支持 XML 与完整手填二选一。查询返回标准化配置，不回显原始 XML；未配置时可省略

bindingType.description_en: HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. Queries return the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be non-empty and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. Existing configurations cannot be replaced. This is different from the entity ID of the service provider (SP) queried on our side
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

x509Certificates.description_en: This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be a non-empty array and use PEM X.509 certificate text. The system verifies the current validity period. A maximum of two certificates are allowed after deduplication
x509Certificates.description_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，去重后最多 2 张

items.description_en: A valid PEM X.509 signing certificate. The example shows a public test certificate for idp.example.com. You must replace it with the certificate of the external IdP for actual integration
items.description_zh: 一张有效 PEM X.509 签名证书；示例为 idp.example.com 的公开测试证书，实际接入须替换为外部 IdP 的证书

status.description_en: The status. Valid values: CONFIGURED (the configuration is accepted and the system is waiting to activate the user pool), SYNCING (synchronizing organization members), SYNCED (organization member synchronization is complete), READY (the binding has taken effect), SYNC_FAILED (organization member synchronization failed), UPDATING (updating the configuration), UPDATE_FAILED (configuration update failed), DISCONNECTING (disconnecting), and DISCONNECT_FAILED (disconnection failed)
status.description_zh: 状态。CONFIGURED（配置已受理，等待开通用户池）、SYNCING（正在同步组织成员）、SYNCED（组织成员同步完成）、READY（绑定已生效）、SYNC_FAILED（组织成员同步失败）、UPDATING（正在更新配置）、UPDATE_FAILED（更新配置失败）、DISCONNECTING（正在解绑）、DISCONNECT_FAILED（解绑失败）
status.title_en: 身份源资源及登录配置状态
status.title_zh: 身份源资源及登录配置状态

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
